title: Libby selected-biomarker survey row
description: One row per biomarker screened against the case by the preclinical_biomarker_surveyor agent. Answers a single question per biomarker: has this patient been tested for it, and if the answer is no or not-firmly-enough, what would it take and what would it open up? Panel sources are data/reference/selected_biomarker_panel.json (protein targets with a binder program) and data/reference/tumor_agnostic_biomarkers.json (pan-cancer and subset predictive biomarkers).

survey_id.description: Stable kebab-case row id, conventionally <panel_key>-<status shorthand> (e.g. 'tacstd2-not-measured', 'msi-dmmr-measured').

panel_source.description: Which reference panel this row came from. Rows are never invented outside the panels.

panel_key.description: Verbatim `panel_key` from the source panel entry. The renderer joins on this to pull binder / therapeutic context.

gene_symbol.description: Primary gene symbol where the biomarker has one. Null for assay-level biomarkers such as TMB.

biomarker_label.description: Human-readable name as it should appear in the report (e.g. 'TROP2 (TACSTD2) protein expression').

relevance_class.description: Why this biomarker is in scope for this patient: established in this tumor type, relevant across a subset of tumor types that includes this one, or predictive regardless of primary site.

relevance_rationale.description: 1-2 sentences on why this biomarker is worth screening in THIS patient. The honest answer for a tumor-agnostic biomarker is that primary site does not matter; say that rather than manufacturing a tumor-specific story.

measurement_status.description: measured_hardened: on file at the resolution clinical decisions require. measured_not_hardened: a result exists but is not decision-grade (wrong modality, RNA-only, unvalidated cutoff, single small biopsy, pending confirmation) — these rows are handed to the target_validator. not_measured: no result on file. not_assessable: cannot be evaluated until a prerequisite resolves (e.g. an HLA-restricted antigen with no HLA type on file). indeterminate: the case record is ambiguous about whether it was measured.

status_evidence.description: Where in the case record the status was read, as artifact pointers (e.g. 'profile.json:biomarkers[2] DLL3 RNA', 'target_validation.jsonl:dll3-ihc-confirmatory'). A not_measured row records what was searched, so 'absent from profile.json:biomarkers[]' is a valid entry. Never cite case/<slug>/ raw PHI.

hardening_gap.description: Required (non-null) when measurement_status is measured_not_hardened: names precisely what is short of decision-grade and what would close it. This string is the payload the target_validator consumes.

recommended_assay.description: The concrete test that would answer this biomarker. Null only when no action is recommended (a measured_hardened row). `bundled_with` is what makes a long gap list practical: it names the single order that carries several of these rows at once.

bundled_with.description: When this assay rides along on a test already recommended elsewhere (a comprehensive NGS panel that reports TMB and MSI together, a single IHC block cut for several stains), name it. Bundling is the main lever for keeping a long not-measured list practical.

therapeutic_implication.description: What a positive result would open up. Drawn from the panel's binder / therapeutic entries, never invented.

indication_match.description: How the intervention's current status lines up with THIS patient's tumor type. The difference between an approved option and a cross-tumor extrapolation is the single most load-bearing distinction in this column.

priority.description: essential: a decision-grade option is being left unassessed and the assay is practical. high: meaningfully changes the option set. medium: refines or adds a trial-only option. low: research-grade or the therapeutic tail is thin.

screening_recommendation.description: The concrete next step. 'no_action' is the right answer for a measured_hardened row and must be paired with it.

rationale.description: <= 3 sentences of clinician-facing prose: what the gap is, what closing it would open up, and the consequence of not closing it. Rendered verbatim into the report table, so write finished prose. No em-dashes (U+2014); the renderer's pre-flight blocks them.

references.description: pmid:* / nct:* / guideline:* / fda:* citations, carried from the panel entry or added by the surveyor. Verified per .claude/snippets/reference_check.md before the row is written.

handoff_to_target_validator.description: True when the target_validator should emit a corresponding hardening row in target_validation.jsonl. Set true on every measured_not_hardened row; may also be set on a not_assessable row whose prerequisite is itself an assay.

supersedes.description: survey_id of a prior row this one corrects or replaces.
